cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py shell
Use `uv` for dependency management—all commands should be run with `uv run python`. Starter scaffold: minimal `/start` bot with user tracking; extend handlers in `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or routers included in `main.py:42`; models in `bot/models.py`, register in `bot/admin.py`; Celery tasks in `bot/tasks.py` using `<REDACTED_USER>_task`. Add env vars to `.env.example`, access via `config/settings.py`.
